title: Daddy Loves Those Toes
subtitle: a tozy song for my little one

lines: Splish, splash goes the water and splash goes the tub,
it's bubbles and duckies and rub-a-dub-dub.
And what's peeking up from the bubbles? Oh my!
Ten little tozies say, "Hi, Daddy, hi!"
Here are the tozies, on the bottom of your feet,
the heel's on the other side. Kick, splash, how neat!
The duck says a quack, and the bubbles go pop,
and ten little tozies say, "Don't ever stop!"
Then out with a whoosh, with a towel warm and wide,
I dry every tozy, from side to side.
A rub on your head and a bop on your nose,
and one extra kiss for those just-washed toes.
Then on to pyjamas, all stars and moons bright,
the top goes on easy, the bottoms are tight.
I wiggle one leg in, and what do you know?
Pop! Out of the bottom, five tozies say hello!
The other leg now, it goes tug, tug, and whee!
Five more little tozies come waving at me.
"Hey, little tozies, get up in those sheets!
Come sleep right next to me, with your little tozy feet!"
So climb up on Daddy, your head's by my knees,
your tozies by my cheeks, if you please, if you please.
Here's one little tozy, and here's tozy two.
Those three in the middle? I don't know them. Do you?
Then five on the other, so cuddly and small,
ten little tozies, and I love them all.
You giggle and squirm when I tickle your feet,
you tell me they're stinky, I tell you they're sweet.
"Why do I need tozies, when my feet are so big?"
So Daddy can kiss them, tickle them, and nibble them too!
They're the most important part when you walk around,
they keep you nice and steady, so you don't fall down.
Those tozies ran out to meet me when I came home through the door,
they danced in the kitchen and stomped on the floor.
These tozies look yummy, a tasty treat!
I'll eat them all up! Nom, nom, nom! Oh, so sweet!
Now into your bed, and the lamp's turning low,
I sing you a sweet song, soft and slow.
I sing to your nose and I sing to your hair,
and I sing to the tozies still wiggling there.
Sleep, little tozies, so cuddly and neat,
the moon's watching over your little tozy feet.
Snuggle down under, so they won't turn blue,
all comfy and cosy, the whole night through.
Your eyes getting heavy, your yawn big and slow,
I tuck in the blanket from tip to toe.
I'll keep them all warm and all safe while you sleep,
ten sleepy tozies, not making a peep.
From the top of your head to the tip of your nose,
oh my, little one, Daddy loves those toes.
